notes.title: From Black Gold to Clean Cash: Playtest Our New Game!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]Greetings Prospectors,[/p][p]The team here wants to extend a huge thank you for all your support on [i]Black Gold Oil Drilling Simulator[/i]. We've seen you build incredible empires, striking it rich and mastering the flow of that valuable black gold.[/p][p]Today, we want to invite you to a new venture. A new business opportunity where the goal isn't to get your hands dirty, but to make sure everything comes out... perfectly clean.[/p][p]We are thrilled to announce that the [b]FREE, limited-time playtest[/b] for our brand new game, [b]Laundering Simulator[/b], is [b]LIVE NOW![/b][/p][p][i]Laundering Simulator[/i] is a business management sim where you'll use your strategic skills to run a laundromat that serves as a front for a burgeoning money-laundering empire. If you enjoy the empire-building and logistical challenges of [i]Black Gold[/i], you'll feel right at home managing finances, upgrading equipment, and staying one step ahead of the authorities.[/p][p][b]Key Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Run a legitimate laundromat business, serving quirky customers.[/p][/*][*][p]Build a secret underground base with wild, money-laundering inventions.[/p][/*][*][p]Manage the heat and avoid the watchful eyes of the FBI.[/p][/*][*][p]Expand your influence and become a tycoon of clean cash![/p][/*][/list][p]🏆 [b]Join the Contest and Win a Free Copy![/b] 🏆 The playtest includes the [b]First Laundering Contest[/b]! Explore the game, uncover a hidden secret, and find your unique contest code. Post it in our official Discord for a chance to be one of [b]10 WINNERS[/b] who will receive a free copy of the full game on release![/p][p]We'd be honored if you, our dedicated simulator fans, would be the first to try it out.[/p][p]👇 [b]Click Here to Join the FREE Laundering Simulator Playtest on Steam![/b] 👇 [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432750/Laundering_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being an amazing community. Let's see if you're as good at washing money as you are at drilling for it![/p]

Strike it rich in the early 20th century oil boom with Black Gold! Immerse yourself in the thrill of hiring a workforce, building up your very own oil field, and tapping into valuable crude oil. Can you overcome the obstacles, endure the crises, and secure a fortune beyond your wildest dreams?
